gloss: reliable; dependable; someone you can count on

definitions.gloss: reliable; dependable; someone or something you can count on
definitions.explanation: Describes a person, thing, or quality that can be trusted and relied upon. Functions as an adjectival expression modifying nouns or as a predicate.

examples.japanese: {頼|たよ}りになる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{頼|たよ}りになる。
⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頼|たよ}りになる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧だ。
examples.english: When you're in trouble, family is what you can really count on.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧ (reliance, dependence — the noun form of ⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become/serve as). Literally "serves as something to rely on." One of the most common ways to express reliability in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Used both as a predicate ({頼|たよ}りになる) and as a noun modifier ({頼|たよ}りになる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧). The negative form {頼|たよ}りにならない means "unreliable" and is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頼|たよ}りになる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — reliable person
- {頼|たよ}りになる⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ — dependable presence
- {頼|たよ}りになる⟦{味方|みかた}→味方：03743_mikata⟧ — reliable ally
- {頼|たよ}りにならない — unreliable, undependable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧ — trustworthy (more formal; emphasizes trust)
- {当|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — can be counted on (often used in the negative: {当|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧)
- ⟦{心強|こころづよ}い→心強い：16315_kokorozuyoi⟧ — reassuring, encouraging (emotional sense of feeling supported)
